purpose: Host-neutral interchange contract for optional live DAP behavioral scenarios.

request.workspace: An isolated writable workspace. The adapter must preserve durable DAP records and return their evidence locations.

result.evidence_rule: A passed or failed execution must return at least one observable evidence record. An unavailable execution must return a non-empty reason and must not be counted as a skill failure.

host_boundary: Harness commands, model identifiers, credentials, tool APIs and durable-state integrations belong to an external adapter. They must not be added to canonical SKILL.md files.
